banks.name: Yishama Stainless (Studio Pre-Gen)
banks.description: Empirically matched Yishama stainless pantam: 140–185 ms nonlinear 2f₀/3f₀ bloom, inverted decay tails (τ₃ > τ₂ > τ₁), gentle dual-axis beating, warm 78 Hz Helmholtz cavity.

banks.name: Yishama Ember Steel (Studio Pre-Gen)
banks.description: Crystalline Ember alloy: luminous extended 2f₀ & 3f₀ shimmer halo, slightly quicker bloom onset, crisp clean articulation without mud.

banks.name: Classic Nitrided Hang (Studio Pre-Gen)
banks.description: Dry, focused nitrided steel character: woody tactile finger-pad attack, tighter controlled sustain, punchy separation for fast rhythmic playing.
